description: This file contains utility functions for testing Mattermost server configurations and plugins using Playwright, including license checks, feature flag validation, server deployment verification, and plugin management.

methods.name: shouldHaveCallsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the calls feature is enabled in the server config.

methods.name: shouldHaveFeatureFlag
methods.description: Verifies if a specific feature flag is set to the expected value.

methods.name: shouldRunInLinux
methods.description: Ensures the test runs only on Linux platform.

methods.name: ensureLicense
methods.description: Checks if the server has a valid license, requests a trial if not licensed.

methods.name: requestTrialLicense
methods.description: Requests a trial license from the server with predefined contact info.

methods.name: skipIfNoLicense
methods.description: Skips tests if the server is not licensed.

methods.name: skipIfFeatureFlagNotSet
methods.description: Skips tests if a specific feature flag is not set to the expected value.

methods.name: ensureServerDeployment
methods.description: Verifies server deployment configuration, especially for HA clusters.

methods.name: ensurePluginsLoaded
methods.description: Ensures specified plugins are installed and active.
